question: Should ClawHub preserve a single lowercase metadata alias for compatibility while rejecting case-colliding paths, or require uppercase metadata filenames everywhere?
rationale: The report requests uppercase enforcement but also proposes lowercase compatibility, and the linked PR implements the narrower collision-rejection policy across several intake surfaces.

options.title: Preserve aliases; reject collisions
options.body: Allow one accepted metadata casing for compatibility but reject any package containing paths that collide under case-insensitive comparison.

options.title: Require uppercase only
options.body: Make uppercase metadata filenames the only accepted package contract and provide an explicit migration path for existing lowercase packages.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases; reject collisions
recommendation.body: Allow one accepted metadata casing for compatibility but reject any package containing paths that collide under case-insensitive comparison.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only identified person directly connected to the active implementation candidate; final contract approval remains a maintainer decision.
